title: feat(spec): declare the params of an `ai:chat` menu entry (AI inquiry home page copy)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSKgz9ETHYnqoAQBZJsbSwEv)_

Fixes #37787

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：应用菜单里 `componentRef: 'ai:chat'`（AI 问询首页）那一项的 `params` 现在有固定格式：标题、说明、输入提示、推荐问题（最多 4 条）。拼错键、超长、填 `agent` / `scope` 会在保存应用时报错并指出位置；每个应用最多一个这样的入口；其他组件菜单项不受影响。侧栏链接到这个页面时不再把参数拼进网址。
- 影响：页面卡 #37788 直接从菜单项读这些配置。今天还没有页面注册在 `ai:chat` 下，所以没有任何现有应用会被拒。
- 要你做什么：这个 PR 改到了生成的 `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md`，属于 Tier H，需要你批准，席位会在你批准后落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/spec/src/ui/ai-chat-nav-params.zod.ts` (new):** `AI_CHAT_COMPONENT_REF = 'ai:chat'`, `AiChatNavParamsSchema` (closed: `title` ≤60, `subtitle` ≤200, `placeholder` ≤100, `suggestions` 1–4 non-empty strings ≤100 each; every key described for the generated docs; `agent` / `scope` refused with guidance, no rename), and two exported checks:
  - `checkAiChatNavParams` — judges `params` only for `type: 'component'` + `componentRef: 'ai:chat'`, re-raising each issue under `params.<key>`. Mounted once on `NavigationItemSchema` (beside `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource`), so it reaches `navigation`, `areas[].navigation`, `children` at any depth and contribution `items`. Not a per-componentRef registry: every other component entry keeps the open record.
  - `checkAppSingleAiChatEntry` — at most one `ai:chat` entry per app across `navigation` and every `areas[].navigation`, any depth; each extra one is refused at its own path, naming the first. Mounted on `AppSchema` after `checkAppLandingItems`.
- **`ui/packages/layout` `resolveHref`:** an `ai:chat` item builds `/apps/<app>/component/ai/chat` with no querystring. Other component items unchanged. Active-item matching already compares pathnames, so highlighting holds (pinned, including with a `?c=` conversation param).
- **`ui/packages/types` app mirror:** chains both spec checks (flat nav arm, `AppComponentSchema`), and the two census tests name them (`imported-defaults-8317`, `spec-object-refinements-7715`).
- Generated: `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `declaration-map`, `authorable-surface/ui.json`, `json-schema.manifest/ui.json` (the JSON Schema `ui/AiChatNavParams` is emitted with the other generated schemas), reference docs, skill refs index, strictness-ledger counts plus its hand-written `ui/` triage row.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@object-ui/types` minor, `@object-ui/layout` patch.

## Why

Card objectstack#37787 (T1 of the AI inquiry home page, epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5027). The page card objectstack#37788 reads these keys off the navigation entry; it is the schema's consumer (ADR-0049 liveness: the keys are declared here and consumed there; `check:liveness` is green because the keys live inside the `params` record, not a walked ledger key). Premise re-measured on `origin/main` `00cb37b0` (branch since merged with main at `b6536238`; spec rebuilt, `check:generated` clean, `packages/spec/src/ui` 6671 and `ui/packages/types` + `resolveHref` 10545 tests re-run green): `params` open at `app.zod.ts:743-744`, querystring serialisation in `NavigationRenderer.tsx` component branch, `ComponentNavView` forwards only querystring strings. All held.

Judgement points for review:
- `Metadata-protocol: added`, as the card asks. Strictly, two documents that parsed before are now refused (bad `ai:chat` params, a second `ai:chat` entry). No component is registered under `ai:chat` today, so no working document is refused; I did not classify it `narrowed`.
- The mount is on the union, not on `ComponentNavItemSchema`: mounting on the arm added a new dropped-refinement site to 29 published schemas' ledger entries, while the union site is already declared. Same posture as `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource` (the exported per-branch schema does not chain it). `app-nav-visible-data-needs-data-source-export.test.ts` now expects two union checks, this one second.
- A package navigation contribution is merged after parse, so an `ai:chat` entry it adds is not counted by the one-per-app check (documented on the function).

Skills-docs: follow-up owed — the `objectstack-ui` skill should teach the `ai:chat` entry once objectstack#37788 ships the page; documenting a menu entry that opens nothing today would advertise an unshipped capability.

## Verification

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` — 905 files: 28583 passed, 1 failed, 1 todo on the first run; the one failure was the union mount-count pin, updated in `c7235ae8`, and that file plus `ai-chat-nav-params.test.ts` re-ran green (57 tests)
- `npx vitest run src/ui/ai-chat-nav-params.test.ts` — 18 tests: each key positive and negative, >4 / 0 suggestions, unknown key, wrong type, `agent`/`scope` guidance, nested `children` and `areas` paths, two entries (same tree and across areas), a non-`ai:chat` component with arbitrary params still parses, JSON Schema projection is closed
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/layout/ packages/types/` (in `ui/`) — 441 files, 10925 passed
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` — all 14 artifacts up to date; `check:liveness`, `check:empty-state`, `check:exported-any`, `check:dual-source-exports` exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`, `ui/packages/{types,layout}` `type-check` exit 0; eslint on touched spec files and both ui packages: 0 errors
- CI fixes after opening: `packages/spec/llms.txt` schema counts (`16d8dafe`); ADR-0122 alias convention, `AiChatNavParams` = `z.input`, `AiChatNavParamsParsed` = `z.infer` (`91fe7925`); L1 wording, the `scope` guidance claims object preference only, since knowledge search has no app filter (`0d0002c8`)
- root: `check:doc-authoring`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:keyed-text-bounds`, `check:release-spec-changes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:sdui-reference` exit 0
